description:
Implement complete, eager irreducibility validation for polynomials over arbitrary supported finite fields, producing the reusable validation certificates the quotient fields consume.

## Background

Runtime quotient construction must fully validate its modulus; validation cost is paid once and captured in a certificate. The existing registry verifies binary irreducibility for specific entries; this operation is field-generic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: gf2-core decides irreducibility for polynomials over supported base fields with a complete algorithm, returning a reusable certificate on success and a typed error naming a witness factor class on failure.
- [hard] REQ-02: Tests cover known irreducible and reducible cases over GF(2), GF(p), and GF(p^r) bases, within fast-tier budgets.
title: Generic irreducibility validation with reusable certificates
